workflows.title: Find fees, funding costs and exposure in a public wallet
inputs: Public account address and mainnet or testnet
UTC startTime and endTime for the activity window
Maximum history pages and explicit coverage limits
workflows.output: Reproducible wallet diagnostics with captured source hashes, observed realized PnL, signed fees and funding, maker/taker costs, current exposure and explicit history gaps.
workflows.access: Bounded official Hyperliquid public info reads; no trading key or wallet connection. Default perpetual activity is distinct from a complete portfolio or verified investment return.

workflows.title: Validate a frozen rule with higher costs and a held-out period
inputs: Absolute dataFile and specFile paths for a sourced daily USD series and frozen rule
Optional splitIndex for the first held-out observation
Baseline fees/slippage and higher-cost assumptions
workflows.output: Separate baseline and higher-cost results for development and held-out periods, same-cost benchmarks, trade logs, input hashes and explicit independent restart accounting.
workflows.access: Local Node.js helper with no wallet or network request; no parameter optimization, live execution or forward-return claim.

workflows.title: Research a Hyperliquid market before planning a trade
inputs: Exact network, market and DEX identity
Research question, observation window and freshness limit
Liquidity, funding and catalyst evidence requirements
workflows.output: Cited market/funding/liquidity evidence, supported thesis and invalidation conditions with data gaps; historical, paper and live evidence stay separate.
workflows.access: Existing official public info reads or explicitly configured tools; market analysis grants no financial authority.

workflows.title: Review a completed trade against its original intent
inputs: Account, market/DEX and completed trade window
Original ticket, risk unit, order/fill identities and exchange history
Signed fees/funding, position changes and incident record
workflows.output: Reconciled trade outcome and cost accounting with a separate process grade, incident findings and one supported follow-up test.
workflows.access: Read-only exchange history and local arithmetic; a profitable result does not establish that controls or authorization were respected.

workflows.title: Capture a bounded market snapshot with source evidence
inputs: Resolved CoinGecko IDs and quote currency
Snapshot or daily-history request, with explicit observation limit
Maximum acceptable age and any comparison provider
workflows.output: Timestamped source observations and raw response hashes, stale/partial coverage, aligned discrepancies and a daily-history envelope when requested.
workflows.access: Bounded public CoinGecko and documented public comparison reads; limits and outages remain explicit. Contract identities need the contract-aware token workflow.

workflows.title: Test a strategy against a reproducible daily price history
inputs: Sourced, ordered daily price dataset with asset identity and units
Buy-and-hold, funded DCA or moving-average rule
Funding schedule, fees, slippage and comparison period
workflows.output: A deterministic next-observation backtest, same-cash-flow benchmark, costs, time-weighted return, drawdown, source hash and explicit model limitations.
workflows.access: Local Node.js helper and a supplied evidence dataset; no exchange, wallet or trading account needed. Daily observations do not prove executable fills.

workflows.title: Review an investment thesis against explicit invalidation conditions
inputs: Exact asset identity and a written thesis
Invalidation conditions and evidence standard
Review frequency and meaningful notification rule
workflows.output: A cited baseline or comparison, verdict for each invalidation condition and unresolved evidence; native scheduling handoff when requested.
workflows.access: Existing public or explicitly connected official data sources; a saved review frequency does not create a running monitor.

workflows.title: Stress-test an Aave V3 position
inputs: Chain ID, Aave V3 market and wallet
Collateral/debt and oracle state at one block
Your proposed borrow, repayment or withdrawal
workflows.output: Current and stressed health factor, debt capacity, reserve restrictions and an unsigned action plan.
workflows.access: Read-only chain RPC or the official Aave client; no wallet connection needed for public address reads.

workflows.title: Inspect a Morpho market or vault
inputs: Chain and market ID or vault address
Asset amount and intended supply or borrow
workflows.output: Market identity, oracle/IRM/LLTV, liquidity and vault allocation or exit constraints.
workflows.access: Official Morpho API and chain reads; market IDs are not token tickers.

workflows.title: Check Compound III borrowing capacity
inputs: Chain and Comet deployment
Wallet and desired base-asset borrow
workflows.output: Base debt, collateral limits, interest exposure and an unsigned borrow or repay plan.
workflows.access: Read-only RPC against the selected Comet deployment.

workflows.title: Track a Lido withdrawal to claimability
inputs: Ethereum wallet or withdrawal request IDs
stETH or wstETH amount if planning a new request
workflows.output: Request ownership, finalized/claimed status, claimable ETH and the next supported step.
workflows.access: Ethereum RPC and official Lido deployment registry; queue timing is not a guarantee.

workflows.title: Compare holding PT to maturity with exiting
inputs: Chain and Pendle market address
PT/YT holdings, valuation time and proposed exit size
workflows.output: Maturity terms, underlying accounting unit, executable exit comparison and post-expiry route.
workflows.access: Official Pendle market/API data and chain state.

workflows.title: Check what a vault withdrawal can return now
inputs: Chain, vault address and share owner
Shares or assets to exit
workflows.output: Preview versus owner limits, rounding, liquidity and asynchronous exit constraints.
workflows.access: Read-only RPC; a share conversion alone does not prove withdrawable assets.

workflows.title: Inspect a Uniswap V3 liquidity position
inputs: Chain and position NFT ID
Token amounts or position sizing budget
Range intent or monitoring question
workflows.output: Position composition, tick bounds, fee state and a bounded liquidity plan.
workflows.access: Official deployments and read-only RPC; explicitly V3, not V4 hooks.

workflows.title: Inspect Slipstream liquidity and gauge rewards
inputs: Base pool and position NFT ID
Wallet and gauge if staked
workflows.output: Range status, gauge custody, fees versus emissions, and exit constraints.
workflows.access: Base RPC and current Aerodrome/Slipstream deployment records.

workflows.title: Prepare a Uniswap quote for review
inputs: Input/output chain and token addresses
Exact input or output amount and wallet
Slippage limit and recipient
workflows.output: Quote identity, route type, approval/Permit2 requirements and unsigned transaction review.
workflows.access: Official Uniswap Trading API access; quotes and permit requests never authorize signing.

workflows.title: Compare a bridge route and reconcile arrival
inputs: Source/destination chains and token addresses
Amount, sender and recipient or existing transaction hash
workflows.output: Net destination amount, gas needs, route limits and destination settlement evidence.
workflows.access: Official LI.FI quote/status API; source confirmation alone is not arrival.

workflows.title: Resolve a token before trusting its price
inputs: Chain and contract address, or explicit CoinGecko ID
Quote currency and freshness requirement
workflows.output: Resolved token identity, timestamped market evidence and unsupported or stale fields.
workflows.access: Official CoinGecko MCP or REST; API tier affects access and freshness.

workflows.title: Screen yields without mistaking emissions for income
inputs: Chain, asset and minimum TVL
Base/reward APY preferences and result limit
workflows.output: A reproducible shortlist separating base yield, rewards, missing fields and exit diligence.
workflows.access: Public DefiLlama yield data or existing official connection; listed APY is not a guaranteed return.

workflows.title: Check AgentKit wallet capabilities
inputs: Intended network and wallet custody model
Existing CDP/AgentKit configuration without secrets
workflows.output: Capability and policy gaps, tested read access and the next required setup step.
workflows.access: Official CDP/AgentKit tools; Coinbase account MCP and Agentic Wallet are separate products.

workflows.title: Review a Hyperliquid account before trading
inputs: Public account address and venue/market
Exposure or funding question
workflows.output: Account mode, margin exposure, funding and market evidence for a trade decision.
workflows.access: Official Hyperliquid public info API; no trading key required for public reads.

workflows.title: Choose a tool without granting excess authority
inputs: Research question, chain and available official tools
Required reads or unsigned outputs
Existing account/cost limits without secrets
workflows.output: A dated capability/access matrix separating public reads, unsigned preparation, simulation, account writes, signing and paid requests; a concrete unsupported-capability result.
workflows.access: Existing official tools and primary docs; discovery does not create wallets, accept delegated permissions or purchase data.

workflows.title: Build a deterministic unsigned transaction plan
inputs: Chain, protocol/version and verified deployment
Sender, recipient, token identities and raw-unit amounts
Action parameters, finite approval limits and current state block
workflows.output: Ordered unsigned prerequisites and payloads, target/value/calldata identity, capability evidence, exact units, continuing permission review and construction limits.
workflows.access: Official protocol builders or version-matched Nethermind playbooks; local construction has no signer and makes no broadcast.

workflows.title: Simulate the exact unsigned payload before review
inputs: Chain, sender, target, value and unsigned calldata
State block and preceding approval/action sequence
Expected balance/allowance changes and permitted provider costs
workflows.output: Exact payload/state identity, simulated balance/allowance changes, decoded errors and trace evidence, artificial overrides and unresolved coverage; no execution guarantee.
workflows.access: Existing official simulation provider or disposable local fork; Tenderly project access, Alchemy quotas or Portals x402 cost remain explicit opt-ins.

workflows.title: Inspect hub and spoke risk at a verified Aave V4 deployment
inputs: Chain, verified V4 hub/spoke and deployment maturity
Wallet, position/reserve state and oracle block
Proposed supply, borrow, repay or withdrawal
workflows.output: Hub/spoke identity, collateral/debt and liquidity, health/capacity and configuration constraints with an unsigned plan; unsupported or preview deployments remain explicit.
workflows.access: Official Aave docs/MCP and read-only chain RPC; no V3 assumptions transferred to V4 and no wallet approval.

workflows.title: Review a vesting or payment stream and its exit rights
inputs: Chain, deployment/module and stream ID or proposed terms
Token, sender, recipient, funding and schedule
Cancellation/transfer rights and the current observation time
workflows.output: Module-specific funding, vested/withdrawable amounts, ownership and cancellation rights, schedule/rounding checks and an unsigned plan or existing-stream reconciliation.
workflows.access: Official Sablier deployments, SDK/indexer and public chain reads; setup and analysis neither fund nor create a stream.

workflows.title: Review streaming obligations and Super Token liquidity
inputs: Chain, verified Super Token and stream/agreement identity
Sender, recipient, signed flow rate and funding horizon
Current balance, deposit and operator permissions
workflows.output: Current flow, claimable/liquid balance, deposit/runway and operator authority; wrapping, cancellation and liquidation constraints with an unsigned plan.
workflows.access: Official Superfluid contracts/SDK and public reads; no wrapping, stream creation or delegated operator grant.

workflows.title: Review a cross-chain quote and reconcile deposit delivery
inputs: Source/destination chains and exact token contracts
Amount, sender, recipient and slippage/fee ceiling
Quote intent or existing Across deposit/transaction identity
workflows.output: Dated route/quote, fees and destination minimum, exact unsigned target/calldata, deposit identity and separate fill/refund reconciliation with unresolved outcomes.
workflows.access: Current official Across API requires configured Bearer access and integratorId. Public chain reads can reconcile a known deposit without sending an action.

workflows.title: Inspect token controls and transaction evidence through a read-only explorer
inputs: Chain ID and exact contract/wallet/transaction identity
Pinned state block and the economic claim to examine
Required code, proxy, balance/flow and exit evidence
workflows.output: Verified source/implementation correspondence, visible controls and transaction/balance evidence with coverage and freshness limits; no unconditional safety score.
workflows.access: Optional keyless Blockscout named reads or existing explorer/RPC; shared gateway limits and indexer lag remain explicit.

workflows.title: Research prediction markets with bounded public evidence
inputs: Exact event/market/condition identity and outcome
Observation window, source limit and liquidity question
Resolution terms and comparison requirements
workflows.output: Cited event/market identity, outcome order, bounded orderbook/activity evidence, pricing/liquidity limitations and explicit resolution uncertainty.
workflows.access: Official Polymarket public APIs or official CLI read commands; no private key, order placement, funding or redemption.

workflows.title: Reconcile prediction market resolution and payout evidence
inputs: Exact market/condition and outcome token identities
Resolution rules, disputed outcome or observed status
Optional public holder/transaction identity
workflows.output: Current resolution state, oracle/dispute/finality evidence and payout/redemption constraints; data evidence is distinct from any actual redemption.
workflows.access: Official public Polymarket data and onchain reads; no claim/redeem transaction, approval or signing.

workflows.title: Inspect Euler collateral, debt and account liquidity
inputs: Chain, EVC account and collateral/borrow vaults
Position size and proposed borrow or exit
workflows.output: Vault and account health, collateral eligibility, oracle/LLTV, borrow liquidity and an unsigned next step.
workflows.access: Official Euler deployment data, EVC and vault reads; a vault share price does not establish account solvency.

workflows.title: Inspect a SparkLend position and reserve limits
inputs: Chain, SparkLend market and wallet
Proposed supply, repayment, borrow or withdrawal
workflows.output: SparkLend collateral/debt, health factor, reserve limits and current liquidity, distinct from Spark savings and Morpho vaults.
workflows.access: Official Spark deployments and read-only Pool/data-provider calls; no financial action.

workflows.title: Inspect a Kamino lending obligation
inputs: Solana cluster, market and obligation or wallet
Reserve mints, proposed amount and risk scenario
workflows.output: Obligation collateral/debt, reserve and oracle freshness, liquidation limits and a bounded unsigned plan.
workflows.access: Official Kamino API/SDK and Solana RPC reads; identify mints and obligations rather than tickers.

workflows.title: Inspect a Save or legacy Solend lending position
inputs: Solana cluster, market and obligation
Reserve mint and intended borrow or exit
workflows.output: Deployment status, obligation health, reserve liquidity and supported next step with unavailable or legacy state explicit.
workflows.access: Verified Save/Solend deployment and Solana account reads; product continuity must be established before planning.

workflows.title: Compare rETH redemption with a market exit
inputs: Ethereum wallet and rETH amount
Exit size, destination and freshness limit
workflows.output: rETH/ETH conversion, available protocol redemption liquidity, market comparison and received-asset evidence requirements.
workflows.access: Official Rocket Pool registry and rETH/DepositPool reads; exchange rate does not guarantee liquid redemption.

workflows.title: Inspect delegated restaking and queued withdrawals
inputs: Chain, staker, strategy and operator
Withdrawal root or intended restaking exit
workflows.output: Strategy shares, delegation/slashing exposure, withdrawal delay and completion eligibility without assuming a queue is claimable.
workflows.access: Official EigenLayer contracts and current withdrawal/delegation state; no delegation or withdrawal submission.

workflows.title: Track a Symbiotic withdrawal through its epoch
inputs: Chain, vault and depositor
Withdrawal epoch and shares or assets
workflows.output: Vault identity, active versus pending balances, epoch eligibility, claim state and returned collateral evidence.
workflows.access: Official Symbiotic deployment and vault reads; epoch eligibility and actual claim completion stay distinct.

workflows.title: Inspect a Yearn vault and owner exit limits
inputs: Chain, vault/version and owner
Share or asset amount to withdraw
workflows.output: Vault identity, share accounting, owner limits, strategy liquidity and loss assumptions with an unsigned exit assessment.
workflows.access: Official Yearn registry and version-specific vault reads; a conversion preview alone is insufficient.

workflows.title: Compare Spark or Sky savings conversion and exit
inputs: Chain, exact savings product and owner
Underlying denomination and proposed exit amount
workflows.output: Savings/share conversion, rate assumptions, owner limits, liquidity and the product-specific exit route.
workflows.access: Official Spark/Sky product deployment and read-only calls; distinguish savings from SparkLend and bridge wrappers.

workflows.title: Inspect EulerEarn allocation and withdrawal capacity
inputs: Chain, EulerEarn vault and owner
Shares or assets and desired exit size
workflows.output: Allocator/strategy exposure, fees, share conversion and available owner exit capacity with unresolved liquidity explicit.
workflows.access: Official EulerEarn vault and strategy reads; allocator access does not make every underlying allocation liquid.

workflows.title: Check sUSDe cooldown and unstaking eligibility
inputs: Chain, staking contract and owner
sUSDe shares, USDe amount or existing cooldown
workflows.output: Current cooldown configuration, owner withdrawal state, share conversion and the supported USDe claim path.
workflows.access: Official Ethena deployment and staking reads; cooldown completion does not establish receipt of USDe.

workflows.title: Review an Ondo product's eligibility and settlement
inputs: Exact product, chain, token and investor jurisdiction
Subscription or redemption question and amount
workflows.output: Product-specific eligibility, transfer restrictions, issuer/custody risk and supported subscription/redemption evidence.
workflows.access: Official issuer documentation and permitted public contract reads; no KYC submission or investor eligibility assertion.

workflows.title: Inspect TBILL eligibility and redemption terms
inputs: Exact TBILL product, chain and holder
Jurisdiction, amount and redemption question
workflows.output: Investor restrictions, vault/share accounting, NAV timing and subscription/redemption settlement conditions.
workflows.access: Official OpenEden product terms and permitted public reads; an onchain token balance does not establish redemption eligibility.

workflows.title: Inspect Curve pool accounting and an LP exit
inputs: Chain, pool generation/address and LP owner
LP amount, withdrawal mode and optional gauge custody
workflows.output: Pool/coin identity, balances, gauge custody, expected withdrawal amounts and an unsigned exit plan.
workflows.access: Official Curve registry, pool ABI and gauge reads; choose the exact pool generation and quote at current state.

workflows.title: Inspect Balancer liquidity and pool exit limits
inputs: Chain, pool version and pool ID/address
BPT amount, owner and desired exit assets
workflows.output: Pool/Vault identity, balances, recovery/paused state and version-specific exit quotation and constraints.
workflows.access: Official Balancer deployment/API and Vault reads; V2 and V3 routing and token accounting differ.

workflows.title: Inspect a Revert-managed liquidity position
inputs: Chain, manager/vault and position NFT
Owner and requested earnings or exit review
workflows.output: Underlying NFT identity, custody/automation permissions, fee/cost accounting and supported withdrawal evidence.
workflows.access: Official Revert interfaces and verified manager/position reads; analytics do not establish custody or exit readiness.

workflows.title: Inspect a VFAT Sickle position and exit dependencies
inputs: Chain, owner, Sickle and farm/gauge
Position identifier and proposed unstake or exit
workflows.output: Sickle ownership, strategy approvals, gauge balances, rewards and ordered unsigned exit dependencies.
workflows.access: Official VFAT deployment/source and contract reads; never reuse a third-party Sickle or assume owner-held NFTs.

workflows.title: Review a 0x quote and exact allowance target
inputs: Chain, token contracts, taker and base-unit sell amount
Slippage, recipient and freshness limit
workflows.output: Quote identity, fees, AllowanceHolder/Permit2 target, simulation caveats and an unsigned swap review.
workflows.access: Official 0x Swap API with its configured API key; credentials and an executable payload grant no signing authority.

workflows.title: Review a 1inch swap quote and execution mode
inputs: Chain, token contracts, base-unit amount, from account and origin EOA
Classic or intent route and price/expiry limits
workflows.output: Route type, allowances, fees, recipient, minimum output and mode-specific fulfillment evidence.
workflows.access: Official 1inch API and configured developer access; distinguish classic transaction execution from intent filling.

workflows.title: Review a CoW order and settlement evidence
inputs: Chain, sell/buy tokens, owner and amount
Order UID or proposed receiver, validity and partial-fill policy
workflows.output: Auction/order identity, signed terms, fees, fill state and actual received assets with cancellation/expiry limits.
workflows.access: Official CoW quote/orderbook reads; no order signature, placement or cancellation without exact authority.

workflows.title: Review a Jupiter Swap v2 route
inputs: Solana cluster, input/output mints and base-unit amount
Optional taker, recipient and slippage policy
workflows.output: Quote route, fees, executable-versus-quote-only status and Solana transaction validity and settlement checks.
workflows.access: Official Jupiter Swap v2 API; keyless quote-only access has limits, while execution requires its own current contract.

workflows.title: Reconcile a Relay cross-chain route
inputs: Origin/destination chain, currencies and recipient
Amount, request ID or source transaction
workflows.output: Quote/step identity, outstanding dependencies, destination delivery and unresolved or refundable state.
workflows.access: Official Relay /quote/v2 requires the configured x-api-key; status access is separately scoped. Origin confirmation does not prove destination delivery.

workflows.title: Review an Across route and destination fill
inputs: Origin/destination chain, tokens, amount and recipient
Integrator identity and quote/deposit or source transaction
workflows.output: Quote fees/limits, deposit identity, fill deadline and actual destination token/recipient/amount or refund status.
workflows.access: Current Across API requires configured Bearer access and integratorId; legacy suggested-fees is not the default route.

workflows.title: Track a CCTP message through attestation and mint
inputs: CCTP version, source/destination domains and recipient
Burn transaction or message hash and USDC amount
workflows.output: Burn/message identity, attestation/finality state, destination nonce consumption and actual USDC mint evidence.
workflows.access: Official Circle attestation API and verified TokenMessenger/MessageTransmitter reads; never equate attestation with a completed mint.

workflows.title: Inspect GMX V2 positions and pending requests
inputs: Chain, account, market and collateral token
Position key or request key and risk scenario
workflows.output: Collateral/margin, funding/borrowing costs, keeper request state and executed/cancelled outcome evidence.
workflows.access: Official GMX V2 SDK/contracts and reads; request creation is distinct from keeper execution.

workflows.title: Review Derive options risk and margin
inputs: Derive subaccount, instrument and expiry
Existing position or proposed order size and limit
workflows.output: Contract unit/payoff, portfolio margin, collateral, expiry/settlement terms and order/fill evidence requirements.
workflows.access: Official Derive market reads and explicitly configured account access; no session-key creation or order submission.

workflows.title: Check Velocity or legacy Drift position support
inputs: Exact current venue/deployment and Solana account
Legacy position identity and requested read or exit
workflows.output: Current service status, supported account reads, position/margin evidence and explicit unsupported or legacy boundaries.
workflows.access: Verify current official Velocity/Drift operating status before relying on legacy SDK endpoints; no inferred migration or live trading support.

workflows.title: Inspect Boros margin and rate exposure
inputs: Chain, market, account and position
Rate direction, maturity and margin/risk assumptions
workflows.output: Implied-versus-realized rate exposure, margin, accrued funding and liquidation/settlement constraints.
workflows.access: Official Boros API/SDK and market/account reads; Boros margin is separate from Pendle V2 PT/YT maturity.

workflows.title: Inspect a Jupiter Perps position and exit request
inputs: Solana position, collateral mint and owner
Market, direction and proposed reduction or close
workflows.output: Position leverage, liquidation/fee assumptions, custody liquidity and request/settlement state.
workflows.access: Official Jupiter Perps program/IDL and Solana RPC; do not apply swap quote or GMX accounting to this program.

workflows.title: Review Snapshot proposal rules and voting evidence
inputs: Space and proposal ID
Voter, choice and intended research or prior-vote review
workflows.output: Proposal identity, snapshot block, strategies, choice encoding, vote validity and execution-module boundaries.
workflows.access: Official Snapshot Hub/GraphQL and space data; an offchain vote result does not prove onchain execution.

workflows.title: Inspect a Governor proposal and timelock state
inputs: Chain, Governor deployment and proposal ID
Targets, values, calldata and proposal description
workflows.output: Proposal state, clock/quorum, exact operation hash, timelock readiness and execution receipt/state evidence.
workflows.access: Verified Governor ABI/current contract reads; custom Governor/Cactus deployments require their own exact interface.

workflows.title: Review a Safe transaction and confirmation state
inputs: Chain, Safe address and Safe transaction hash or unsigned payload
Expected recipient, values, operation and nonce
workflows.output: Decoded effects, owner threshold, confirmations, nonce, modules/guards and executed transaction/state evidence.
workflows.access: Official Safe Transaction Service and onchain Safe reads; a proposed transaction or collected signature is not execution authority.
